weather_agent.description: Level 3a/3b: Weather agent with RAG, CoT, Memory, ToT, GoT. Runtime config via state params: enable_rag (bool), enable_cot (bool), use_memory (bool), enable_tot (bool), enable_got (bool). Defaults from .env: ENABLE_RAG/ENABLE_COT

weather_hitl_workflow.description: Level 1: HITL workflow with hurricane approval for Category 3+ storms

multi_agent_workflow.description: Level 4a: 3-agent system with triage, hurricane specialist, and alert manager. Routes queries through conditional logic based on query type and risk level.

level4b_workflow.description: Level 4b: 8-agent orchestration with supervisor, triage, hurricane specialist, forecaster, historical analyst, research, reflection, and alert manager. Supports parallel execution and quality reflection loops.
